<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.194, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of approximately 267.19 Da. A plausible molecular formula that matches this mass is C₁₄H₁₉O₅.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H19O5</final_answer>
